notes.title: Night Reverie is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The day has finally arrived!

Night Reverie is OUT NOW on Steam for PC!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670/Night_Reverie/][img]https://i.imgur.com/ux6PM2z.png[/img][/url]

Time to put on your best Night Explorer clothes and join Matt and Sparky on their adventure to find out the truth behind the distorted house.

Watch the launch trailer here:

[previewyoutube=sQ9EYQ1cVg4;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re giving 10% launch discount specially for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670/Night_Reverie/

We thank our translation team for their hard work. Thanks to them, Night Reverie can be enjoyed by more people in their languages!

- Russian - Dmitry Kornyukhov and Maria Serova
- Italian - Valentina Varone
- Chinese (Simplified + Traditional) - Indienova team
- Spanish - Arturo Anci

Localization to other languages will be added in future updates so stay tuned for more news!

We're really excited to finally be able to share this game with all of you! 
We hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoy making it. If you love the game, please leave a review and feedback. We’d love to hear from you! <3


Follow us on Twitter!
[url=https://twitter.com/SomberPixel]@somberpixel[/url]


Join the community!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/2DPmTeP][img]https://i.imgur.com/LY59Tno.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Night Reverie is Coming Out on October 8th!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Mark the date on your calendar and prepare your best Night Explorer clothes, 
Night Reverie will be available on Steam on October 8th, 2021 @ 8:00am PDT!

We're so delighted to share this news with you and we hope you look forward to the release as much as we do!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670/Night_Reverie/][img]https://i.imgur.com/6Ogae2s.png[/img][/url]

It's been almost two years since this amazing, sometimes tough, yet wonderful adventure started. 
We can never thank you enough for all the support you've given us. THANK YOU ALL! 

Matt, Sparky and friends are waiting for you!

You can watch the Steam Release Date Announcement Trailer here:

[previewyoutube=pHIADt9y4Y8;full][/previewyoutube]

More details about the release:
The game will cost 9.99 USD, and you will be able to get it with a 10% discount during the first week after the release.

The game will release in English, Spanish, Italian, Chinese (Simplified + Traditional) and Russian!
Localization to other languages will be added in future updates so stay tuned for more news!

Here is what you can do if you don't want to miss the release:

1. Press "Add to wishlist" and "Follow" buttons if you haven't yet.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670/][img]https://i.imgur.com/9JMgAJ9.gif[/img][/url]

2. Add the event to your Google calendar. Just follow this [url=https://calendar.google.com/event?action=TEMPLATE&tmeid=N2hjcnA2bG11bDlmY2I3a2dtOXU4ZmxoNjcgY191YzdsY3QybHI0bzd0bmhjbTBubXJ1dGR2OEBn&tmsrc=c_uc7lct2lr4o7tnhcm0nmrutdv8%40group.calendar.google.com]link[/url] and press "Save":

[url=https://calendar.google.com/event?action=TEMPLATE&tmeid=N2hjcnA2bG11bDlmY2I3a2dtOXU4ZmxoNjcgY191YzdsY3QybHI0bzd0bmhjbTBubXJ1dGR2OEBn&tmsrc=c_uc7lct2lr4o7tnhcm0nmrutdv8%40group.calendar.google.com][img]https://i.imgur.com/HtRlPSE.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Language Update 1: Chinese and Italian
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Night Reverie: Prologue is now available in the following languages:

[list]
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian (new)
[*] Simplified Chinese (new)
[*] Traditional Chinese (new)
[/list]
We are also thrilled to announce that we are now working with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indienova]Indienova [/url]as a publisher to bring Night Reverie to more players in China.

We are really thankful to all players who have downloaded and played Night Reverie: Prologue. It’s really heartwarming reading your feedback on the game. We guarantee we are putting 100% effort to bring you the best possible experience in the complete game: Night Reverie.

Of course, we will progressively translate the game to many other languages. We want Night Reverie to be enjoyed by everyone.

You can support us immensely by adding Night Reverie to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670

Feel free to join us on this beautiful game development adventure:

[url=https://discord.gg/2DPmTeP][img]https://i.imgur.com/oA6eEIa.png[/img][/url]
